reviews.comment:
Siendo socia no me dejaron entrar al baño. Mala atención de la empleda del full. Para darme un termo de agua me retuvieron el carnet y me mandaron a un baño en el exterior que ni siquiera cierra la puerta. De noche no se puede visualizar el controlador de aire. Buena atención de los playeros.

(Translated by Google)
As a member, I wasn't allowed to use the restroom. The employee at the full-service station was very helpful. To give me a thermos of water, they held onto my membership card and sent me to an outside restroom that doesn't even close. The air conditioning control panel is invisible at night. The attendants were helpful, though.
